# Upstream notice materials

These copied license/reference files retain their upstream terms. They do not change the first-party MIT OR Apache-2.0 choice. `npm-notices.json` binds exact npm releases, source-package file hashes, upstream URLs and copied material hashes.

The collector reads these files offline. Build recipes are reference text and are never executed. The Apache build-repository license does not replace LGPL/native component terms. Prepared attribution is identified as such; missing copyright statements are not invented. No file here attests artifact compliance or completes corresponding-source/relinking review.

See [publication review](../docs/security/publication-review.md).

See the [version/source rationale and unresolved findings](../docs/security/upstream-notices.md) before using these materials in a release.
